_readme: Every model score sits beside every named baseline on the SAME folds. Numbers are out-of-fold (held-out); nothing here is in-sample. Headline = primary dataset, leave-one-B-family-out. The Sr3BiX3 holdout is scored once per dataset, fit on the whole dataset, and used for no choice.

bootstrap.paired: same resample indices for every model within a dataset

plus_unverified.description: primary plus the source_unverified v1 rows (Ca3BiX3, Ca3AsCl3)

sr3bix3_holdout.note: n = 3. Scored once; cannot rank models. Reference: Islam et al., New J. Chem. 2026, 50, 522, doi 10.1039/d5nj02800k (PBE). Other PBE reports for Sr3BiI3: 1.164 (CASTEP) and 1.30 eV (WIEN2k) vs the 1.324 target.

primary.description: GGA-PBE without SOC (soc no/unknown), median per formula; preprint rows included

sr3bix3_holdout.note: n = 3. Scored once; cannot rank models. Reference: Islam et al., New J. Chem. 2026, 50, 522, doi 10.1039/d5nj02800k (PBE). Other PBE reports for Sr3BiI3: 1.164 (CASTEP) and 1.30 eV (WIEN2k) vs the 1.324 target.

soc.description: GGA-PBE+SOC, median per formula; a separate target, never pooled with no-SOC

verified_only.description: primary minus preprint rows (arXiv 2604.01942); source_unverified never included

sr3bix3_holdout.note: n = 3. Scored once; cannot rank models. Reference: Islam et al., New J. Chem. 2026, 50, 522, doi 10.1039/d5nj02800k (PBE). Other PBE reports for Sr3BiI3: 1.164 (CASTEP) and 1.30 eV (WIEN2k) vs the 1.324 target.

gpr_physics9.description: StandardScaler + GPR, ARD Matern(5/2) + white noise (v1 kernel)

rf_magpie.description: RandomForest, grid by inner grouped CV

rf_physics9.description: RandomForest, grid by inner grouped CV

ridge_magpie.description: VarianceThreshold + StandardScaler + SelectKBest(f_regression) + Ridge on Magpie; k, alpha by inner grouped CV

xgb_magpie.description: XGBoost (shallow), grid by inner grouped CV

xgb_physics9.description: XGBoost (shallow), grid by inner grouped CV

splits.gkf: GroupKFold(5) by formula x10 shuffled repeats; MAE = mean over repeats

target: GGA-PBE band gap (eV), no SOC (the soc dataset is PBE+SOC)

v1_reproduction._note: v2 code on the uncorrected v1 file. v1 contains two HSE06 labels stored as PBE (Mg3BiI3, Mg3BiBr3); the v2 datasets fix them. These numbers check the code, not the data.
